title: Directional derivatives of a C^2 weak solution solve the differentiated system
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, L := L(R^n, R^l), U an open subset of R^n, a : R^n -> (continuous bilinear forms on L), Phi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L), v : R^n -> R^l and e in R^n. Assume x ↦ a(x)[P][Q] (all P, Q) and x ↦ Phi(x)[P] (all P) are C^1 on U, v is C^2 on U, and the integral over U of a(x)[Dv(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over U of Phi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta : R^n -> R^l with tsupport zeta ⊆ U. Then there is Psi : R^n -> (continuous linear forms on L) with Psi(x)[P] = D(Phi(.)[P])(x) e - D(a(.)[Dv(x)][P])(x) e for x in U and P in L (Dv(x) frozen in the second term), such that, with v_e(z) := Dv(z) e, the integral over U of a(x)[Dv_e(x)][Dzeta(x)] equals the integral over U of Psi(x)[Dzeta(x)] for every C^1 compactly supported zeta with tsupport zeta ⊆ U.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (e : Rn n), IsOpen U → (∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => a x P Q) U) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun x => Φ x P) U) → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 v U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ v x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ∃ Ψ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, Ψ x P = fderiv ℝ (fun z => Φ z P) x e - fderiv ℝ (fun z => a z (fderiv ℝ v x) P) x e) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ (fun z => fderiv ℝ v z e) x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Ψ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)
